description: Latchkey's own recent log on this server, for finding out why something in Latchkey isn't working: its connection to the relay, pairing, settings, pause, updates, and the audit check. Newest last, one line each: time, category, ERROR when it was one, text. It holds no tool calls, commands, file names, or the relay's address. Optional: lines (default 200, up to 1000) and category (one kind only).

lines.description: How many of the newest lines (default 200, up to 1000)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

name: latchkey_log
title: Latchkey's Log
